text: DSH MCP Center 是面向 DSH Web 的 MCP 管理中心，在侧栏提供服务器管理页，并通过 Host API 管理已配置服务。用户可以浏览内置 MCP 服务目录、手动填写或导入 JSON 配置，按全部会话、工作区或单个会话设置范围，并选择让模型自动调用工具或通过命令手动调用。页面还提供服务状态、工具列表、连接测试和手动调用台；也可用 /mcp 命令或 mcp_manager 工具管理服务器。连接需要的服务地址和凭据取决于用户配置的 MCP 服务器。

DSH MCP Center adds an MCP page to DSH Web. Browse the catalog, add servers by form or JSON import, set session scope, and choose automatic or manual calls. View tools, test connections, or run tools in a console. Manage servers with /mcp or mcp_manager. Endpoints depend on configured servers.
想在 DSH 网页里集中添加和管理 MCP 服务。
Can I import an MCP server list from JSON and choose which sessions can use it?
I need to call an MCP tool manually from a DSH command or a small web console.
DSH MCP Center 的功能「管理并调用 MCP 服务」：在侧栏添加或导入服务，设定会话范围和自动/手动模式，并查看工具、测试连接或在调用台运行工具。也可用 /mcp 或 mcp_manager 管理。
DSH MCP Center 会把调用参数交给所选 MCP 工具，并将工具结果返回给 DSH；实际连接目标由配置的 MCP 服务器决定。

dsh-mcp-center-ui README · dsh-mcp-center：One page for every MCP server in DeepSeek Harness: browse a curated marketplace, add a server from a manual form or a pasted `mcpServers` block, scope it to all sessions / a workspace / a session, and choose automatic or slash-command invocation.

[](https://github.com/AidenX0704/dsh-mcp/actions/workflows/ci.yml)

dsh-mcp-center-ui README · dsh-mcp-center：The `license` / `node` / `dsh` / `tests` badges are plain shields.io badges, not live services. The `ci` badge reflects `.github/workflows/ci.yml` and only shows a status once that workflow has run.

dsh-mcp-center-ui README · What it does：- **Sidebar entry `mcp`** (order 40, after Plugins / Automations / Skills Center) that opens the MCP Center page in the main column.
- **Three tabs**: *Configured* (status, command or URL, tool count, scope, invocation mode, enable / edit / test / expand / delete), *Marketplace*, *Invoke*.
- **Marketplace** ships 19 curated real MCP servers plus one offline demo server: category filter, search, requirement badges (key / OAuth / Node / Python / uv / Docker / network), and a quick-add dialog generated from each entry's `fields`.
- **Two ways to add a server**: a manual form (stdio or streamable-http, command, args, env, URL, headers, timeout) and a JSON import that understands Claude Desktop / Cursor `mcpServers`, VS Code `servers`, or a single `{command}` / `{url}` object — several servers at once, with a preview before anything is created.
- **Scope** — all sessions, specific workspaces, or specific sessions. Out of scope means those tools are not merely discouraged: they leave that session's tool list and are rejected at execution.
- **Invocation mode** — `auto` puts the tools in the model's tool list; `manual` hides them and keeps them reac

dsh-mcp-center-ui README · Install：The plugin is a DSH bundle. **This local build is installed by absolute path** (recorded as a `link:` dependency, so edits take effect with no release step); a git URL or `.tgz` also works, but never the npm name — `dsh-mcp-center-ui@0.2.0` on the registry keeps DSH from booting (see the warning above).

**1. Plugins page (Web GUI)** — sidebar **Plugins** → install → paste the repository URL:

```
https://github.com/AidenX0704/dsh-mcp
```

dsh-mcp-center-ui README · Install：Then reload the page with **F5** — the Client half loads at page start, so the sidebar entry appears only after a reload.

**2. Agent tool call** (needs a `danger-full-access` session):

```json
{"action":"install_bundle","target":"https://github.com/AidenX0704/dsh-mcp"}
```

The `github:AidenX0704/dsh-mcp` shorthand works for the same call.

**3. Pin a release tag** (any git ref or commit works):

```
https://github.com/AidenX0704/dsh-mcp#v0.1.0
```

dsh-mcp-center-ui README · Install：**4. npm registry.** The package is published as `dsh-mcp-center-ui` — the bare `dsh-mcp-center` name on npm belongs to an unrelated project, so this one carries a `-ui` suffix:

```json
{"action":"install_bundle","target":"dsh-mcp-center-ui"}
```

Further paths — local development checkout (`link:`), `npm pack` tarball, registry — and what each one records in the profile `package.json` are in [docs/install.md](docs/install.md).

dsh-mcp-center-ui README · Quick start：1. Install the bundle (one of the three snippets above) and reload the page (F5).
2. Open **MCP** in the sidebar → **Marketplace** tab.
3. Find **Local demo server** (`demo`, category *Built in*) — no network, no `npx`, no credentials — and press **Quick add** → **Create**.
4. Back on **Configured**, the card turns green with 4 tools: `echo`, `add`, `now`, `list_dir`.
5. Switch to **Invoke**, pick `demo`, pick `echo`, set the arguments to `{"text":"hello"}`, press **Run**.

dsh-mcp-center-ui README · Quick start：The same call from the composer:

```
/mcp call demo echo {"text":"hello"}
```

dsh-mcp-center-ui README · Tabs and controls：| Tab | What it holds |
|---|---|
| Configured | One card per server: status light, transport badge, invocation badge, command + args or URL, tool count, scope summary, status message. Row actions: enable switch, **Scope**, **Test**, **Edit**, **Details** (tool list + mode switch), delete (two-step confirm). Stats row: configured / enabled / tools. |
| Marketplace | Search box, category chips, one card per entry: title, id, summary, transport, auth badge, requirement badges, `verified <date>`, **Docs** link, **Quick add**. |

dsh-mcp-center-ui README · Tabs and controls：Control-by-control manual: [docs/usage.md](docs/usage.md).

dsh-mcp-center-ui README · Scope：| Scope | The model sees the tools when |
|---|---|
| All sessions | always |
| Workspaces | the session belongs to one of the selected workspaces, or its working directory is inside one of those workspace paths |
| Sessions | the session id is in the selected list |

dsh-mcp-center-ui README · Scope：A server that is out of scope for a session is denied twice: its `mcp__<server>__*` tools are removed from that session's tool list, and any attempt to execute them — including the shared `list_mcp_resources` / `read_mcp_resource` tools addressed by `server` — is rejected.

dsh-mcp-center-ui README · Auto vs manual：| Mode | Model tool list | How tools run |
|---|---|---|
| `auto` | contains `mcp__<server>__*` (subject to scope) | model calls them directly; `/mcp call` and the console still work |
| `manual` | does not contain them | only `/mcp call`, the Invoke console, or `mcp_manager {"action":"call"}` |

dsh-mcp-center-ui README · `/mcp` command：| Command | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `/mcp list` | All configured servers with mode, scope and tool count |
| `/mcp tools [server]` | Discovered tool names (all servers, or one) |
| `/mcp call <server> <tool> [json]` | Run one tool manually |
| `/mcp add <name> <json>` | Create a server from a connection config |
| `/mcp rm <server>` | Delete a server and its generated bundle |
| `/mcp enable <server>` / `/mcp disable <server>` | Toggle a server |
| `/mcp auto <server>` / `/mcp manual <server>` | Switch invocation mode |
| `/mcp scope <server> <all\|workspace\|session> [ids…]` | Set scope |
| `/mcp test <server> [tool] [json]` | List the server's tools, or call one |
| `/mcp market [query]` | Browse the bundled catalog |
| `/mcp` (no arguments) | The same list as built-in help |

dsh-mcp-center-ui README · `mcp_manager` tool：| Argument | Used by | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `action` (required) | all | `list`, `tools`, `market`, `add`, `update`, `remove`, `toggle`, `test`, `call` |
| `id` | update / remove / toggle / test / call | Target server id |
| `config` | add | One server `{command,args,env}` / `{url,headers}`, or a `{mcpServers:{…}}` / `{servers:{…}}` document |
| `patch` | update | Editable fields: title, description, transport, command, args, env, cwd, url, headers, mode, scope, enabled |
| `enabled` | toggle | Desired enablement |
| `tool` | test / call | Raw tool name or full `mcp__server__tool` |
| `arguments` | test / call | JSON arguments |
| `query` | market | Free-text filter |

dsh-mcp-center-ui README · Security and data：- **Loopback only.** The page talks to the Host over `/api/dsh-mcp-center` on the Web GUI's own port. A non-loopback request is answered `403` unless the plugin config sets `allowRemote: true` and the caller is a paired remote device.
- **Secrets stay in the Host.** `env` and `headers` values are masked in every response (`••••`, or first 3 + `••••` + last 2 characters). The page never receives a stored secret, and an untouched field is submitted empty and keeps its stored value.
- **`env:NAME` indirection.** Instead of storing a token, set the value to `env:GITHUB_TOKEN`. The generated bundle then contains a live `process.env.GITHUB_TOKEN` reference, and the secret never enters `state.json`.
- **State on disk.** `$DSH_HOME/mcp-center/state.json` (`~/.dsh` by default) is written with mode `0600`, because it can contain API keys. On Windows the effective permissions come from the directory ACL, so treat the file as sensitive either way.
- **Full Host privileges.** This is an ordinary in-process DSH plugin: it runs inside the Host with the same privileges as any other bundle row, can spawn the `stdio` processes you configure, and can read
dsh-mcp-center-ui README · Security and data：Exact schema and rules: [docs/configuration.md](docs/configuration.md).

dsh-mcp-center-ui README · Compatibility：| Requirement | Value |
|---|---|
| DSH runtime | `>=0.2.0-rc` (verified against 0.2.1-rc.5 / desktop app 44.7.0) |
| Node.js | `>=22` (the Host's runtime starts `stdio` servers) |
| Browser | the Harness Web GUI; the Client half loads at page start |
| External tools | `stdio` marketplace entries need `npx`, `uvx`, or `docker` on `PATH`, plus network access on first run |

dsh-mcp-center-ui README · Compatibility：The MCP protocol is not implemented here: framing, handshakes, tool calls and resources are delegated to the shipped `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client`. This plugin only materializes configuration for it.

dsh-mcp-center-ui README · Update and uninstall：Installing over an existing package reports `already-installed`. The supported update is remove, then install:

```json
{"action":"remove_bundle","target":"dsh-mcp-center-ui"}
```

```json
{"action":"install_bundle","target":"https://github.com/AidenX0704/dsh-mcp#vX.Y.Z"}
```

dsh-mcp-center-ui README · Update and uninstall：The Plugins page exposes the same remove / install controls. Restart DSH when a change reports `restart-required`; press F5 for Client-half changes. Uninstalling removes the plugin row and its generated server bundles; your configuration stays in `$DSH_HOME/mcp-center/` and can be deleted by hand.

dsh-mcp-center-ui README · Update and uninstall：**Upgrading from 0.1.x:** the distribution name changed from `dsh-mcp-center` to `dsh-mcp-center-ui`, so the row the bundle inserts no longer resolves against the old profile entry. Remove the old row once (`{"action":"remove_bundle","target":"dsh-mcp-center"}`) and install the new one; `$DSH_HOME/mcp-center/state.json` and the generated `@dsh-mcp-center/server-<id>` bundles are re-materialized from your saved configuration, so every server comes back with its scope and mode.
dsh-mcp-center-ui README · Update and uninstall：Full policy, tag rollback and `link:` ↔ release migration: [docs/update.md](docs/update.md).

dsh-mcp-center-ui README · Development：No install step and no build step — the package has zero runtime dependencies.

```bash
npm test                    # offline: Host harness, Client smoke, demo selftest, MCP stdio probe
npm run test:host
npm run test:client
npm run test:demo
npm run demo                # run the demo MCP server on stdio

dsh-mcp-center-ui README · live end-to-end test against a running GUI (creates and removes a demo server)：node test/run.mjs --e2e
DSH_WEB_URL=http://127.0.0.1:3637 node test/e2e-http.mjs
```

To develop against your own checkout, install by absolute path — DSH records a `link:` dependency, so edits are picked up after a rebuild / reload:

```json
{"action":"install_bundle","target":"C:\\Users\\you\\dsh-mcp"}
```

dsh-mcp-center-ui README · Known limitations：- **Removing a stored secret from the panel is not wired up.** Clearing a key/value row in the edit dialog keeps the stored value (`""` means "unchanged"). The Host API does accept a delete: `POST /api/dsh-mcp-center/action` with `{"action":"update","id":"<server>","patch":{"env":{"KEY":null}}}`. Prefer `env:NAME` refs so the secret never lands in `state.json` at all.
- **Uninstall the plugin before its generated bundles.** If `dsh-mcp-center` is removed while `@dsh-mcp-center/server-<id>` rows are still installed, those servers keep loading through `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` with no scope or invocation-mode enforcement. Delete the servers first (Configured → delete), or remove the leftover rows from the Plugins page.
- **OAuth-only marketplace entries have no OAuth flow.** Notion and Sentry are listed for their tool surface but will answer `401` until you add a token-based server instead; the GitHub and Linear entries use plain PAT headers.
- **`state.json` mode `0600` is exact on POSIX and advisory on Windows**, where the file inherits the directory ACL. Treat the file as sensitive on every platform.
